about.title: About
about.paragraph1: Emma Cochet is an interior architect based in Paris, who graduated from the Royal College of Art in London. Her background has fostered a particular sensitivity to enhancing and respecting what already exists, in a subtle dialogue between old and contemporary.
about.paragraph2: This approach extends into her furniture collection, where she gives antique pieces a new life through a bold language.
